# להצליח עם חיוך – סיון גומבוש (didactics.co.il)

> Sivan Gombosh (סיון גומבוש), MA, is a certified didactic diagnostician (Hebrew University of Jerusalem) and remedial teacher in Rehovot, Israel. She offers remedial teaching, didactic and psycho-didactic assessments, MOXO attention testing, study-skills workshops, first-grade readiness workshops, and a mentoring program for new remedial-teaching teachers. The site is in Hebrew.

- Clinic address: שדרות ח"ן 46, רחובות (Chen Boulevard 46, Rehovot)
- Phone: 052-8219395
- Email: sivan@didactics.co.il
- Area served: Rehovot and the surrounding area

## Pages

- [Home](https://didactics.co.il/): who Sivan is, her approach ("every child can learn and succeed with a smile"), testimonials
- [About](https://didactics.co.il/about): background, education and experience
- [Services](https://didactics.co.il/services): remedial teaching (reading, writing, math, English, learning strategies), didactic assessment for learning disabilities, psycho-didactic assessment, MOXO test
- [Teacher mentoring](https://didactics.co.il/mentoring): a personal mentoring program for remedial-teaching teachers starting out
- [Workshops](https://didactics.co.il/workshops): "Learning how to learn" for grades 5–8, and first-grade readiness for kindergarteners
- [Blog](https://didactics.co.il/blog): articles on remedial teaching, learning, assessment and values
- [Contact](https://didactics.co.il/contact): contact form and details
- [Directions](https://didactics.co.il/directions): how to get to the clinic
